title: From idea to impact
description: A structured, battle-tested process that takes digital products from initial discovery to high-impact production scale.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Understand the business, users, goals and technical requirements.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Translate requirements into product experiences and technical architecture.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Engineer the product using modern technologies and scalable practices.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Test, deploy and validate the product in real-world environments.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Optimize, improve and expand as the business grows.
